title: Oral health-related quality of life of patients with class II and class III dentofacial deformity before and after orthognathic surgery: a prospective cohort study
html: Dentofacial deformities affect patients’ oral health-related quality of life (OHRQoL) and orthognathic surgery is commonly used to correct these skeletal deformities. Currently, few studies have compared patients with class II and class III dentofacial deformity using validated tools, with control groups and longer-term follow-up. This study evaluated OHRQoL in 94 patients with class II (n = 28) and class III (n = 66) dentofacial deformity before (baseline) and 1 (M1), 3 (M3), and 6 (M6) months after orthognathic surgery, using the Chinese version of the Orthognathic Quality of Life Questionnaire (OQLQ).
